description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git diff commands, particularly comparing blobs and trees in a git repository.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Executes a git diff with full index and outputs to diff file.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks if the diff contains the expected index line for given sha1s.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Verifies mode changes in the diff output.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Verifies the diff includes the specified file paths.
